primary_user: Independent hourly workers whose billable work includes research, review, waiting, and judgment.
job_to_be_done: Record work sessions and turn a week into a client-readable, self-reported receipt without surveillance.
problem: Activity trackers miss valuable thinking work and collect more detail than clients need. Workers need a credible explanation of time without pretending it is independent proof.
constraints: Work-session data stays on the current device.
The core workflow works offline after the first visit.
Receipts always identify the record as self-reported.
Evidence links are optional and never fetched by the app.
Users can export and import their own data.
A demo never reads or writes the real-data namespace.
scope: Project, outcome, interruption, optional evidence link, and AI-assisted disclosure
Weekly receipt preview and PDF download
not_in_scope: Activity monitoring, screenshot capture, or keystroke logging

leverage_decisions.ai: Not added. The job is accurate self-reporting; generated claims about completed work would reduce trust.
leverage_decisions.import_export: Required so local records remain portable.
leverage_decisions.sync: Excluded to preserve the local-only privacy boundary.
